# Active Directory Gotchas

> Known Active Directory patterns that cause silent failures or hard-to-debug errors.

## Entries

- [Multi-homed DC + stale DNS corrupts a newly promoted DC's local KDC (unrepairable)](multihomed-dc-corrupt-kdc.md): sc_verify OK but klist 0x52e = corrupt local KDC; fix DNS/single-home before dcpromo, else metadata-cleanup + rebuild. HIGH.
